review.notes:
ReFineID is a smart-card driver. It makes the certificates on a Finnish identity card (FINEID) available to the operating system, so Safari and other apps can use them to sign in to e-services; on Mac it also signs documents with the card's qualified certificate.

There is no account to demonstrate. The app has no login, no server, no registration, and collects no data. Nothing in it sits behind credentials, so there is no user name and password we can supply: none exists.

What the app needs is the card itself. A FINEID card is a legal identity document issued by the Finnish Digital and Population Data Services Agency to one named citizen. It cannot be duplicated, shared, or issued for testing, so we are unable to put one in the reviewer's hands.

Verifiable without a card:
- The app launches and reports its state rather than failing: on Mac "Present your identity card to the reader"; on iPhone the setup screen.
- iPhone: entering any card access number and basic code and tapping "Read Certificate from Card" opens the system NFC scan sheet, which shows the card-reading path is wired up and asks for hardware we cannot ship.
- Settings: the PIN pane (change and reset tasks, with the card's attempt counters) and the time-stamp authority list.
- Every screen in English, Finnish and Swedish, and with VoiceOver, larger text, and the dark interface.
- Mac: the bundled CryptoTokenKit token extension registers with the system on first launch. It appears in the smart-card system's driver list with no card present, which is the product's whole purpose.

The complete source is public at https://github.com/ReFineID/ReFineID-Apple, including the card protocol, so the behaviour behind the card can be read directly.

If a demonstration mode is the expected remedy for an app whose hardware is a personal identity document, please say so and we will add one.

promotionalText.macos: Log in to services with your identity card and sign documents.
promotionalText.ios: Log in to services with your identity card.

description.macos:
A reader for the Finnish identity card.

Insert your identity card into a USB smart-card reader and sign in to e-services directly in Safari with the certificate on your card. Drop a PDF on ReFineID to sign it with a qualified signature.

ReFineID is open source: github.com/ReFineID/ReFineID-Apple
description.ios:
ReFineID brings the Finnish identity card to iPhone and iPad.

Read your card with a USB-C smart-card reader, or wirelessly on iPhone, then sign in to e-services directly in Safari with the certificate on your card.

ReFineID is open source: github.com/ReFineID/ReFineID-Apple

description.macos:
Suomalaisen henkilökortin lukija.

Aseta henkilökortti USB-kortinlukijaan ja kirjaudu sähköisiin palveluihin suoraan Safarissa kortin varmenteella. Pudota PDF ReFineID:hen ja allekirjoita se hyväksytyllä sähköisellä allekirjoituksella.

ReFineID on avointa lähdekoodia: github.com/ReFineID/ReFineID-Apple

Lue korttisi USB-C-kortinlukijalla, tai iPhonessa langattomasti, ja kirjaudu sähköisiin palveluihin suoraan Safarissa kortin varmenteella.

En läsare för det finländska identitetskortet.

Sätt identitetskortet i en USB-kortläsare och logga in på e-tjänster direkt i Safari med kortets certifikat. Släpp en PDF på ReFineID för att underteckna den med en kvalificerad elektronisk underskrift.

ReFineID är öppen källkod: github.com/ReFineID/ReFineID-Apple
